newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia rubber ends down on weakness, Tokyo close.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia rubber ends down on weakness, Tokyo close.

text.p: Malaysian rubber prices ended lower on Tuesday as sentiment stayed weak while the futures market in Tokyo was closed for a holiday, traders said.
"The market was dead as usual and with the close in Tokyo, there were no leads," said a trader.
The Malaysian Rubber Exchange and Licensing Board quoted May RSS 1 at 277.50 cents ($1.10) a kg, down half cent from Friday. May SMR 20 buyer ended one cent lower at 261.50.
Trading houses offered the SMR 20 at 261 cents a kg, SMR CV at 332, SMR L at 310, SMR 5 at 256, SMR 10 at 257 and drum latex FOB at 228.
Traders said prices were expected to be under pressure through the week, with demand forecast to stay bad while supply of latex streams in steadily after the wintering period.

The INRO five-day moving indicator was quoted at 209.86 Malaysian/Singaporean cents per kg on April 28, compared to the 210.94 on April 25. The daily indicator also ended lower at 208.61 from 208.84 previously.
